top_concerns: Headline 'matches or exceeds' claim holds only for Clarity/Responsiveness; Purity is worse and Faithfulness is ~0 for all methods
Small evaluation (~250 features x 4 layers, one model), no variance or significance tests, LLM-based FADE metrics
Possible selection bias: WeightLens covers only 25-59% of features, and it is unclear whether baselines are compared on the same subset
CircuitLens full-distribution results are often below baselines; best results use top-activation sampling; no ablation of clustering, hyperparameters or prompt effects
Circuit attributions are not causally validated and compute and scalability claims are not quantified
